profile: Texas Roadhouse operates and franchises casual dining and fast-casual restaurants under the Texas Roadhouse, Bubba’s 33 and Jaggers concepts. Texas Roadhouse serves steaks, ribs, seafood and other meals; Bubba’s 33 offers burgers, pizza, wings and additional dishes; Jaggers serves burgers, chicken sandwiches, tenders, salads and milkshakes. Restaurants provide dine-in service, with delivery available at many Bubba’s 33 and Jaggers locations.
